platforms.name: MuckRock
platforms.reason: Best documented public record, communication and attachment mapping; default to public reads only.
platforms.jurisdiction: United States: federal, state and local records; jurisdiction-specific handling.
platforms.next_experiment: Offline fixtures for one public request, agency, communication and file; later authorise a bounded public-read smoke.

contract.read_surface: HTTPS api_v2: requests, communications, files, agencies and jurisdictions.
contract.authentication: Some operations are public; account access tokens protect other operations.
contract.write_semantics: Filing is authenticated; credits and account policy must be reviewed separately. No writes approved.
contract.rate_limit: 15 requests/minute generally, with a burst allowance of 100; users and organisations 5/minute without bursts.
contract.privacy: Public records can still contain personal information; exclude user/organisation enumeration from the pilot.

platforms.name: FragDenStaat / Froide
platforms.reason: Suitable public request/public-body model; deployment-specific schema and throttling still need fixture evidence.
platforms.jurisdiction: Germany; EU access regimes must remain explicitly distinguished.
platforms.next_experiment: Freeze one public request/public-body response and reconcile deployed schema/auth; do not assume the framework docs URL exists on the instance.

contract.read_surface: Froide API v1 exposes requests and public bodies, with search endpoints.
contract.authentication: Public reads are documented by Froide; FragDenStaat documents OAuth application registration.
contract.write_semantics: Authenticated account operations are separate; no submission enabled by this inventory.
contract.rate_limit: No numeric deployment quota verified in the reviewed primary documentation; obtain current limits before live use.
contract.privacy: Keep source jurisdiction, redactions, attribution and personal-data retention explicit.

platforms.name: FOIA.gov
platforms.reason: Agency/component catalogue is useful; agency ingestion is not a general-purpose public filing API.
platforms.jurisdiction: United States federal agencies and components.
platforms.lineage: US DOJ national portal / Drupal JSON API (not Alaveteli)
platforms.next_experiment: Offline agency-component and request-form fixtures; live catalogue smoke requires an operator-supplied API key.

contract.read_surface: Agency components, agency-specific form metadata and annual-report XML.
contract.authentication: Portal API requires an API key supplied in X-API-Key.
contract.write_semantics: Agency API is portal-to-agency POST delivery; shared-secret controls are distinct from public catalogue credentials.
contract.rate_limit: Reviewed agency draft explicitly does not specify rate limits; verify portal/key quota separately.
contract.privacy: Do not acquire requester identities or attachments through a catalogue adapter.

platforms.name: USCIS FOIA/PA
platforms.reason: Identity-sensitive case workflow requires onboarding and scope-specific consent, not bulk public discovery.
platforms.jurisdiction: United States USCIS FOIA/Privacy Act case workflow.
platforms.next_experiment: Review sandbox contract and required interface text offline; no credentials, real subjects, case creation or polling in default CI.

contract.read_surface: Case-status operation; not a public corpus or general agency catalogue.
contract.authentication: USCIS developer onboarding and OAuth; exact current version/scopes must be confirmed in sandbox.
contract.write_semantics: POST case creates a FOIA case; production prerequisites and required interface text apply.
contract.rate_limit: No numeric quota independently verified; published guidance describes daily case-status checks.
contract.privacy: Identity, representation and consent documents require separate access and retention controls.

platforms.name: Canada ATIP Online
platforms.reason: No general-purpose transaction API identified in reviewed sources; preserve manual routing and separate released-summary discovery.
platforms.jurisdiction: Canada federal institutions; IRCC application records have a distinct routing path.
platforms.lineage: Government of Canada ATIP portals (not Alaveteli)
platforms.next_experiment: Document institution routing and manually supplied export formats; investigate released summaries separately from request submission.

contract.read_surface: Official request guidance, institution routing and released-request summaries; no transaction API established by this review.
contract.authentication: Portal/account workflow; do not automate accounts, private status or response packages.
contract.write_semantics: Official forms/portal submit requests and may involve payments; manual only.
contract.rate_limit: No programmatic quota verified; no unattended portal traffic authorised.
contract.privacy: Personal-information requests and response packages must not be treated as public data.

platforms.name: India RTI Online
platforms.reason: No general-purpose public request API identified; the portal is not a state-government-wide endpoint.
platforms.jurisdiction: India central ministries/departments and listed central public authorities.
platforms.next_experiment: Prepare manual routing guidance and consent-aware export fixtures; do not automate payment, CAPTCHA, OTP or filing.

contract.read_surface: Public portal guidance and listed authorities; status/response access is applicant-specific.
contract.authentication: Account is not mandatory for filing; status access includes registration/contact and OTP controls.
contract.write_semantics: Forms file applications/appeals and route payments; state-authority submissions are outside portal scope.
contract.rate_limit: No documented API quota located; no automated portal polling authorised.
contract.privacy: Applicant identifiers and status/reply contents are sensitive. TLS verification remains mandatory regardless of legacy help text.
